description: Use this after export_asset, once the user has the editor open: says whether the files are made, and when they are, returns them with a command that downloads them into a folder (bash and PowerShell) and where they go next in App Store Connect or the Play Console. The command's links work until the export expires (24 hours after export_asset); each call with the files ready makes new links and retires the earlier ones, so run the command from the latest call. Pass the handle too when you exported something you made in this conversation; then it needs no sign-in, else it needs the user signed in (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves).

handle.description: Instead of asset_id: the project_handle create_project returned or the design_handle create_design returned, for something you made in this conversation that the user has not saved yet. Needs no sign-in.

name: get_export
title: Get an export's files
